subject: Request: SOC 2 post-report bridging playbook + evidence routing
messages:
From: Obsidian Health Legal <contracts@obsidianhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@grayhawk-audit.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 coverage for post-report period — request for bridging letter and evidence onboarding

Hi Soojin,

We are in final stages of our vendor review and noticed Redwood's last SOC 2 Type II report ends 2023-12-31. Our procurement/legal team requires either a SOC 2 Type II with a later end date or a bridge/continuity letter that covers the period from 2024-01-01 through the current date.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a signed bridge letter or an interim assertion that: 1) affirm controls in scope remained in place, 2) notes any material changes or exceptions, and 3) routes signature via DocuSign?

In addition we need an onboarding packet for evidence: access logs sample (last 90 days), change management checklist for production deployments, KMS rotation policy excerpt, and SOC 2 control owner contact list. Please advise expected turnaround and where to upload sensitive artifacts.

Best,
Maya Singh
Sr. Counsel, Obsidian Health
contracts@obsidianhealth.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Obsidian Health Legal <contracts@obsidianhealth.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@grayhawk-audit.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 coverage for post-report period — request for bridging letter and evidence onboarding

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear list and for looping in Elena. We can provide a signed bridge/continuity letter that covers the post-report period and a scoped evidence package. High-level plan and asks below: 

1) Bridge letter: we will draft a short assertion confirming that controls in-scope for the 2023 Type II period remained in place through today, note any non-material changes, and include an attestation from our VP Security. We will route via DocuSign once you confirm the signing contact at Obsidian. Please confirm whether you need legal countersignature or simply an acknowledgement on your side.

2) Evidence package: we can produce the items you listed. To be specific we will prepare: access logs (redacted) for the last 90 days, change management summary and proof-of-review artifacts, KMS rotation policy excerpt, and a control-owner contact spreadsheet. For sensitive artifacts we prefer secure SFTP or an encrypted Drive folder — see links below for our preferred delivery methods.

3) Timeline: draft bridge + evidence index by Tue 2027-04-05; delivery of redacted evidence bundle by Thu 2027-04-08. If Elena needs to review earlier we can prioritize logs.

Attachments: requested_evidence_index.csv (index + minimal file list), bridge_template_draft.docx (working draft).

Next steps: Maya, confirm DocuSign recipient and whether Obsidian requires a notarized signature or specific language. Elena, if Grayhawk needs any additional auditor wording or formal language, flag it and we'll incorporate.

Thanks,
-- 
Soojín Lee
Head of Trust Operations
Redwood Inference
soojin@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: SOC 2 coverage for post-report period — request for bridging letter and evidence onboarding (internal)

Soojín / Laura — draft language suggestions below for the bridge assertion. Kept it concise to satisfy procurement reviewers: 

"Redwood Inference asserts that the controls included in the SOC 2 Type II report dated with an audit period ending 2023-12-31 remained suitably designed and operationally effective from 2024-01-01 through 2027-04-08, except as noted below. Any changes to control procedures during the interim period are described and were subject to governance review. The assertion is based on internal evidence and third-party audit results available to Redwood, and is provided solely for the benefit of Obsidian Health for vendor risk assessment purposes."

Notes and next steps: 1) call out material exceptions if any (I checked change log; no policy exceptions flagged), 2) include a short paragraph on ongoing monitoring (weekly vulnerability scans, monthly access review cadence), 3) recommend a doc version that does not attempt to extend auditor opinion — keep it an internal attestation + auditor confirmation of receipt if Elena signs the bridge template.

I'll assemble the SOC mapping matrix (SOC2-summary-matrix.xlsx) and a minimal evidence index for Elena's review.

-Rishi
Director, Compliance Programs

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Obsidian Health Legal <contracts@obsidianhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 coverage for post-report period — request for bridging letter and evidence onboarding

Thanks team — a couple of operational/legal notes: 

- DocuSign routing: Redwood will originate the DocuSign packet. Please confirm the recipient order. Obsidian Legal should be second if you require countersignature. We will include a single paragraph referencing control scope and period.
- Evidence delivery: redact PII from logs; we will provide a sample subset in the bundle and offer a controlled session for Elena (auditor) to stream the logs if needed.
- Approval: final signature will be from VP Security. Legal has pre-approved the template language below; if Obsidian requires changes we can negotiate via markups on the draft.

Attachment: SOC2-summary-matrix.xlsx (control-to-evidence mapping).

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com

From: Elena Morales <elena@grayhawk-audit.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Obsidian Health Legal <contracts@obsidianhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: SOC 2 coverage for post-report period — request for bridging letter and evidence onboarding

Thanks — Grayhawk can review and append an auditor acknowledgement if Redwood provides: 1) the bridge template as a working document, 2) a traceable evidence index (we prefer file manifests), and 3) an auditor-only access path for logs (secure temporary SFTP or shared drive link with MFA). A few clarifications: 

- Auditor acknowledgement: we do not extend the original opinion; we can include a short statement confirming we reviewed the supplied evidence and noting the date of our acknowledgement. That wording must remain distinct from the auditor opinion in your 2023 report.
- Evidence redaction: acceptable to provide redacted logs but include a mapping to original log fields so our review can validate sampling.
- KMS: provide rotation schedule and last-rotation timestamp for keys that protect production workloads.

Once we receive the draft bridge and the evidence index we can prep an auditor-acknowledgement addendum for DocuSign.

Elena Morales
Senior Manager, Grayhawk Audit Partners
elena@grayhawk-audit.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Obsidian Health Legal <contracts@obsidianhealth.com>, Elena Morales <elena@grayhawk-audit.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 15:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 coverage for post-report period — request for bridging letter and evidence onboarding

Hi Maya / Elena — consolidated next steps and timeline: 

1) We will finalize the bridge assertion using Rishi's proposed paragraph and send the working draft by end of day 2027-04-08. Attached: bridge_template_draft.docx and SOC2-summary-matrix.xlsx.
2) Evidence index (requested_evidence_index.csv) will enumerate file manifests. We will upload redacted samples to a secure SFTP server and provide temporary credentials. SFTP path (read-only, expires 2027-04-15): sftp://secure.redwoodinference.com/obsidian/onboarding-2027-04 (credentials to follow via separate secure channel).
3) DocuSign: Redwood will prepare the packet and route signatures in this order: Redwood VP Security -> Obsidian Legal -> Grayhawk (auditor acknowledgement). Please confirm if Obsidian needs an additional internal approver. DocuSign packet link (will be live after we upload): https://docusign.com/prepare/packet/REDW-OBS-2027-04

We intend to deliver the full redacted evidence bundle by Thu 2027-04-08. If Elena wants an auditor-only review session for logs earlier, we can schedule a shared screen on Friday 2027-04-09.

Thanks everyone — looping in Rishi and Laura for execution.

-- 
Soojín Lee
Head of Trust Operations
Redwood Inference
soojin@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments referenced in-thread: requested_evidence_index.csv, bridge_template_draft.docx, SOC2-summary-matrix.xlsx
